exclude_collision_pairs: add contact-exclude elements to an MJCF model for body pairs whose geoms cannot collide based on contype and conaffinity
review_contype_conaffinity_logic: review the contype and conaffinity bitmask check logic used to determine if two MuJoCo geoms can collide
optimize_mujoco_simulation: optimize a MuJoCo simulation by excluding collision detection between body pairs that cannot collide due to contype and conaffinity settings
check_geom_collision_compatibility: check if any geom pair between two MuJoCo bodies passes the contype and conaffinity collision compatibility check
summarize_collision_exclusion: summarize how the module excludes collision detection between MuJoCo body pairs using contype and conaffinity parameters
